name: com.oauth.huaweibranch.view.login.oneSDKSelfLoginView
description: When a user chooses account-and-password login, this CIBMall Huawei Branch page accepts the credentials and links to guest sign-in, password recovery, and registration.
disableEffect: Disabling it blocks account-and-password sign-in and the guest, recovery, and registration options on this page.
